subject: general
question: In a code language, ‘POST’ is written as ‘KLHG’, ‘MAIL’ is written as ‘NZRO’. How will ‘TOKEN’ be written in that language?
solution: The positional value table is as follows: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] The pattern followed here is: **Their opposite positional alphabets are written in the places of letters in the following manner.** • In POST → KLHG •
